dossier.headline: Artefacto LS 16 Woven Floor Lamp
dossier.summary: The Artefacto LS 16 is a handwoven wicker floor lamp designed by Mexico City studio Lørdag & Søndag and sold through MESO. It is woven from G'noo Xombé Nisin fiber by master artisan Don Claudio in the Sierra Madre Oriental of Oaxaca, Mexico, with no interior metal structure — the weave alone carries the piece.

facts.label: Material
facts.value: Woven G'noo Xombé Nisin wicker fiber, no metal structure

story.title: Woven by a master artisan
story.detail: The lamp is hand-woven by master artisan Don Claudio in the Sierra Madre Oriental mountain range of Oaxaca, Mexico, using G'noo Xombé Nisin fiber named in the local Mazatec language.

story.title: Structure without metal
story.detail: The piece is built without any interior metal frame; the woven fiber alone carries the structure, a technique Adorno describes as unusual and technically demanding.

story.title: Sculpture and lamp
story.detail: Presented as functional art lighting, the Artefacto LS 16 is categorized under the biomaterial discipline and can be used as a sculpture or a standing lamp.

references.title: Contemporary Mexican collectible design
references.detail: 1stDibs lists the Artefacto LS 16 among 21st Century and Contemporary Modern Mexican floor lamps, situating it within contemporary Mexican design made from wicker and natural fibers.

references.title: Boho functional-art lighting
references.detail: Adorno's editorial on boho lighting profiles the lamp for its fiber-only structure and positions it within functional art lighting.

references.title: Biomaterial discipline
references.detail: Adorno tags the piece under its Biomaterial discipline and Open Editions catalog alongside other natural-material designer lamps.

styling: Place in a reading corner to cast warm, diffused light through the woven fiber
Pair with natural wood and rattan furniture for a tonal, textural setting
Reshape gently by spraying with water if the fiber bends; clean only with a dry cloth
Let it stand as a sculptural object against a plain wall

product.title: Nanimarquina Tres Rug in Ocher
product.description: Nanimarquina Tres Rug in Ocher The Tres Collection embodies nanimarquina's dedication to artisanal excellence, honoring the time-honored tradition of weaving. This collection seeks to return to fundamentals, celebrating intricate details while preserving cultural heritage. Tres is an authentic Indian flat-weave Dhurrie rug distinguished by its three-part construction, where varying fibers take precedence in each section. The interplay of wool, felt, and cotton creates subtle tonal shifts and weaving irregularities that animate the design. This collection represents a study in transparency, presenting the weaving mechanics with educational clarity—unapologetically exposing the warp structure. The fringe details reveal the construction methodology, accentuating how the three components ultimately merge seamlessly into a unified whole.
